xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
Antara Purukul Senior Living Limited ("APSLL"), wholly owned subsidiary of the Company: An assessment of APSLL pertaining to Assessment Year 2022-23 was completed and a demand notice of ₹ 1,113.19 lakhs was issued by the Income Tax Department. APSLL has filed an appeal against the notice, for rectifications of prima facie discrepancies on the records with Commissioner of Income Tax Appellate {"CIT(Appeals)"}. Considering the request for rectification, the CIT has adjusted accumulated losses and issued revised order dated 22.11.2024 with a demand of ₹162.45 lakhs.
To accelerate the hearing process, a request letter also submitted with Principal CIT.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The assessment was completed and a demand of ₹ 1,113.19 lakhs was computed. The company have filed rectifications against mistakes prima facie on records & appeal against the disallowances has also been filed with CIT(Appeals). Considering our request on rectification, CIT has adjusted accumulated losses & issued revised order dated 22.11.24 with demand of ₹ 162.45 lakhs. Stay of Demand has been granted by AO on 24/02/2025.Hearing Notice from CIT was received on 18/08/2025 against which we had submitted our ground wise response on 01.09.2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Proceedings were initiated u/s 263 of the Act pertaining to sale of shares of Max Neeman BV on January 18, 2019. Demand raised ~ INR 29.33 crores . The Company has received a letter u/s 154 from AO to increase the demand from 27.15 Crs to 29.33 Crs.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company filed objections, AO went ahead with an enhanced demand through rectification order dated 22.11.25. The Company again filed rectification dated 12.12.25 with the objections stating that the demand is to be reduced. The matter under section 263 is pending with the High Court. Next date of hearing is February 18, 2026.
